Talo...@hotmail.com wrote:
>
> I'm a little confused. Is the Elder Library program considered
> official? If so when will all these new rulings and cards be put out
> in the next version?

The program is a fan-made program, as listed on the web site.
Like the fan-made foreign translations of the rulebook, the information
therein is assumed to be correct, but if it differs from the information
on the white wolf site, the white wolf information is to be used, since
it is official.

> Is the Lasombra site and the ruling info on it official? If so why
> isn't there a link to it from the WW VTES site?

Similarly.
Lasombra's page is linked from the links page.
The info there is assumed to be correct, but if it differes from the
white wolf information, then the white wolf information is to be used.

As the author of ELDB I can say most assuredly that the ELDB database
is not "official". The official card text can be found online at

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/Cardlist.html

I use the official card text as the basis for the ELDB database, and
incorporate any errata, rulings or clarifications as they are made to
the official card text.
